nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Clearly Corrective Daily Re-Texturizing Triple Acid Peel

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive or redness-prone skin are the most frequent commenters and mostly report the peel is gentle enough to avoid burning or redness, though a few note purging or a broken-out patch where skin is thinnest, like the forehead.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or dry-flaky skin report the peel does not over-dry them and often say it helps a moisturizer sink in better afterward.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report clearer, brighter, more even skin with occasional breakouts, and reduced oily appearance.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the peel reduces the oily appearance of their skin and leaves it smooth for makeup without added irritation.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s report a brighter, less dull, more toned complexion after a few weeks of consistent use.

concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report fading of dark spots, hyperpigmentation, and post-acne marks after several weeks of consistent use, describing brighter, more even-toned skin; one reviewer with combination skin says results are noticeable but not complete after two weeks.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone or congested skin report clearer skin, fewer active breakouts, and reduced closed comedones, with some describing a brief purging period of small breakouts before improvement; one reviewer with severe stress-related acne saw overnight improvement.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers, including several with sensitive or redness-prone skin, report the peel does not cause redness and in some cases reduces existing redness; a couple mention slight tingling or temporary sensitivity the day after use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the peel as surprisingly non-drying for a daily acid product, though a handful report some dryness or tightness, particularly around the nose and cheeks, that they manage with a moisturizer afterward.

aspects.libelle: Lightweight, watery texture that absorbs fast
Small bottle empties quickly with daily use
Pricey but a little goes a long way

extraits.texte: Pros: did not burn, skin felt softer and smoother right after using Cons: skin felt sensitive the day after and i was worried to stay in the sun, some skin purging (small acne)

I have sensitive skin prone to dryness but also oiliness in certain parts of my face, along with acne mostly focused on my nose and forehead. I haven't noticed much of a difference yet, but my skin does seem a bit less dull. I am pleased that this product did not break out my skin or cause any allergic reactions. I haven't been using it for long so I don't have results yet, but I have high hopes for it.

extraits.titre: A gentle peel from the comfort of your own home
extraits.texte: Thank you to Kiehl's who gifted me this product to try. The packaging has a high end feel. The texture is a little watery, so I was skeptical. But a little goes a long way. There is no sting when you apply it, but you can feel the sensation of it working. This product has a higher acid % than many OTC- so patch test first. It was great on my nose, chin and cheeks, but the thinner more sensitive skin on my forehead broke out a little so I stopped using it on that area. I noticed smaller pores and fantastic skin turnover. It also lightened an area with some sun damage. My skin looked fresh & healthy- brighter and less dull from the harsh new england winter..

extraits.titre: I would buy this product again!
extraits.texte: I have combination skin with occasional breakouts and hyperpigmentation. I recently tried this product I applied the acid peel once a week, leaving it on for about 5 minutes before rinsing it off with cool water. Initially, I experienced a slight tingling sensation, but it was bearable and subsided quickly. After the first use, I noticed my skin looked brighter and smoother. Over several weeks of consistent use, I saw significant improvements in my acne scars and overall skin texture. However, I did experience some dryness, especially around my nose and cheeks, which I managed by using a hydrating moisturizer afterwards. Compared to other acid peels I've used, this stood out for its effectiveness in brightening my skin without causing excessive irritation. I would highly recommend it to anyone dealing with dullness or mild pigmentation issues. Overall, I rate this Acid Peel 4.5 stars out of 5 for its noticeable results and gentle yet effective formula. Remember to patch test before full application and use sunscreen daily while using this product. I hope this review helps! Happy skincare journey!

extraits.titre: My skin is much less congested
extraits.texte: This product is the real deal! I have dealt with horrible acne most of my life and while it's mostly calmed down, I still right really congested skin. No red flares, but lots of closed and open comedones (whiteheads and blackheads). Within a day of starting this, I noticed brighter skin, within a week I noticed a reduction in my skin's congested appearance. My skin looked smoother, brighter, and wore makeup better. I like the dropper for dispensing product, and I love that I can't see through the bottle so I know when I'm running out. Overall, love this skin product and I would buy more in a heartbeat.

extraits.titre: Leaves a nice texture to my skin with little irritation!
extraits.texte: I have combo to oily sensitive skin with larger pores. I used this product once a week, and had little issues. It left my skin feeling smoother the next day. I've worked up to twice a week, and it works even better. It says it can be used daily, but see how your skin reacts before going straight to that schedule. It reduces the oily appearance and leaves my skin smooth for make up. I don't think it's done much for hyper pigmentation but I've only had it for two weeks, so it's too soon to say. It's worth trying and see how it works for you!

extraits.titre: I would switch to this product for sure
extraits.texte: I am 50 years old and always had great skin when I was younger but I'm seeing the effects of age now. The Kiehl's Clearly Corrective Daily Re-Texturizing Triple Acid Peel has helped my skin to show less texture and look more radiant. It is gentle on my skin and my skin does not turn red or feel irritated at all like with some other acid products. I will keep using this and I'm looking forward to seeing the results over the long-term. I would definitely recommend to a friend.
